verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents its own CLI for scripted, non-interactive installation, licensing, password setup, connection, and silent removal, which works with deployment tools. It also offers a REST API and an open-source Python module for automating account and session tasks. Nothing documents running the product headlessly or inside CI pipelines, and the automation centers on IT deployment rather than unattended agent workflows. missing for 10: explicit headless/no-GUI operation mode, CI pipeline usage or examples, hands-on or independent corroboration of scripted automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The AnyDesk Command-Line Interface (CLI) allows advanced users and IT administrators to automate installation, configuration, connection, and removal tasks.
For automated or script-based removal without user interaction, use the --remove parameter. To ensure the process runs silently without showing any messages or prompts, add the --silent option
You can start a session using CLI parameters. This is useful for automation or if you're integrating AnyDesk with other systems.
The **AnyDesk REST API** lets you automate the retrieval and management of account data
